case_title: Fresh stock record on a standard SKU
exception_description: Order WH-P01-2047 for SKU CHR-18 is due in 4 hours. WMS shows 24 units in the pick bin, the cycle count finished 90 minutes ago, and no abnormal movement has been flagged.
layer1_visible: Order WH-P01-2047 for SKU CHR-18 is due in 4 hours. WMS shows 24 units in the pick bin, the cycle count finished 90 minutes ago, and no abnormal movement has been flagged.
detail_expand: Reserve stock is available in a nearby location, but pulling from it adds walking and repacking time. The last 7 days show only a 2% variance rate for this SKU. The customer is standard B2C, so avoidable handling is more costly than the small residual risk in this case today.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends packing from the current bin because the record is fresh and a reserve pull would add handling without reducing meaningful risk.

decision_options.action_label: Pause to check latest inbound/outbound scans

current_disruptions.description: WMS stock count may not match physical pick-bin quantity

traceability_text.trace_rationale_short: Fresh data supports direct execution with minimal friction.
traceability_text.trace_more: Audit log stores count timestamp, user approval, and stock snapshot.
traceability_text.recommended_check: Review the last inbound and outbound scan pair in WMS.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: The pick-bin record was correct, so the order shipped normally with only routine handling cost.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The manual check confirmed the stock, but the verification step consumed labor and time.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: Reserve stock was available, but the extra travel and repack created needless handling cost.
